SELECT A.BUSICD AS busiCd, B.BUSINM AS busiNm, A.START_IP AS startIp, A.END_IP AS endIp, A.COMMENT AS comment, DATE_FORMAT(A.CREATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %T' ) AS createDt, (SELECT X.ADMIN_NAME FROM UI_ADMIN X WHERE X.ADMIN_ID = A.CREATE_ID LIMIT 1) AS createId, DATE_FORMAT(A.UPDATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %T' ) AS updateDt, (SELECT X.ADMIN_NAME FROM UI_ADMIN X WHERE X.ADMIN_ID = A.UPDATE_ID LIMIT 1) AS updateId FROM UI_BUSI_IPRANGE A, UI_BUSI B WHERE A.BUSICD = B.BUSICD
AND ( B.BUSINM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchStr}, '%') OR A.COMMENT LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchStr}, '%')
OR INET6_ATON( #{searchStr} ) BETWEEN INET6_ATON(A.START_IP) AND INET6_ATON(A.END_IP)
OR A.START_IP LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchStr}, '%') OR A.END_IP LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchStr}, '%') )
ORDER BY A.BUSICD, A.START_IP, A.END_IP
LIMIT ${offset}, ${limit}
